_comment: Declaring a board model before its hardware exists. A type describes a model, not a board on the bus - and naming the wrong firmware family for one is silent, because an undeclared family resolves to the conventional ~/<name> and simply builds nothing.

mutations.name: an undeclared family is refused when a type is created
a type is created with the family it asked for
swapping the source tree warns that provenance cannot see it
an edited firmware family is actually stored
